subject: Human Body
title: Growth Hormone
description: A quick, practical guide to Growth Hormone.

hook.text: Most growth hormone is released during deep sleep. Children who sleep poorly may literally grow less.

buildup.text: Growth hormone (GH) is made by the pituitary.

discovery.text: GH acts indirectly through the liver, which produces IGF-1. That's the molecule that actually stimulates tissue growth.

twist.text: Too much GH in childhood causes gigantism. Robert Wadlow, at 2.72 meters, had a pituitary tumor making excess GH.

climax.text: Growth hormone doesn't stop after puberty.

punchline.text: You grow while you sleep. Growth hormone works the night shift.

quiz.question: When is most growth hormone released?
